proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2485 ekādaśa explicitly gives Chilis/Gowro aiyāš, Palula akāš/akōš and Hindi igārah, with Western Pahari gyāra in the addendum. These variant eleven forms fit the full historical numeral compound. Reviewed comparator: kaithal gyarah “eleven” (f_vjmifwypzpdtc). Any uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages remains open under the user’s preference; source phonetic details are preserved.
